# DiceBox Campaign Helper — Kurth Tower Reception M02 | Standalone Injector BUILD (Provisional)

**Build status:** `OFFLINE_BUILD_LOCAL_QA_PASS / NOT_STAGE_APPROVED / NOT_READY_TO_PLAY`  
**Artwork:** user-selected M02 structural grayscale (exact source SHA256 `a342988f238b42162af2052ed37fc4513c9dff1553e6c64a83273aeb5c4371f4`), no generated substitute. The selected PNG is encoded to a compact embedded WebP for a one-macro transport; WebP is visually lossy. At install time the macro resizes it to 4800×2880 and verifies the uploaded asset digest.  
**Geometry:** manually reconciled selected-art candidate, 15/15 local checks. **Critical remaining review:** exact exterior tower entrance/bridge-to-hall continuity, inherited M01 Walls, and final wall/path gameplay canaries are not certified. The macro only creates the explicitly listed 8 static Walls, 3 checkpoint Doors and 4 nonfunctional GM-only Regions; this is **not** exhaustive walling.  
**Foundry target (recorded earlier, must be reconfirmed by macro):** world `world-template-2`; Foundry `14.367`; system `dnd5e` `5.3.3`; enabled DiceBox Campaign Helper `0.1.15`; sole active GM.  
**Exact-world identification:** automatic via `game.world.id`; no typing. The install preview must explicitly be approved. 

**Review note:** The separate M02 workflow normally uses structural BUILD, then painterly RENDER and FINAL_INSPECT before STAGE/INJECT. This user-requested *grayscale* injector is a **test-build candidate**, not evidence of passed painterly review or authorization to mark the Scene Ready-to-Play. It may be run only after the current geometry and live-install gates are deliberately reviewed.

### Script Macro

Copy the following **single** JavaScript block into a **Foundry Script Macro**, save it, and run it only after reviewing the change list. Cancel the preview to make no changes. No other macros or separate asset uploads are required.

```javascript
(async () => {
  // DICEBOX_BUILD_CONTRACT: dicebox-scene-injector-build/v2
  // DICEBOX_SINGLE_MACRO: true
  // DICEBOX_SCENE_ID: dbx.heist.kurth.m02.reception

  // DICEBOX_V21_PHASES: PREPARE -> GEOMETRY -> GRAYSCALE -> STRUCTURAL_INSPECT -> BUILD -> PAINTERLY_RENDER -> FINAL_INSPECT -> STAGE -> INJECT -> VERIFY -> RECEIPT

  // DICEBOX_DISCOVERY_NOTICE_POLICY: flat-d20-no-modifiers
  // DICEBOX_DISCOVERY_NOTICE_STATE: per-character-once-until-reset

  // STRICTLY PROVISIONAL: selected grayscale art and partial reviewed wall set.
  // No painterly approval, gameplay certification, teleport behavior, or full exterior walling.
  const DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE = Object.freeze({
    gridType: 0, gridSize: 120, distance: 5, units: "ft",
    logicalColumns: 40, logicalRows: 24, width: 4800, height: 2880
  });
  const EXPECT = Object.freeze({
    core: "14.367", system: "dnd5e", systemVersion: "5.3.3",
    module: "dicebox-campaign-helper", moduleVersion: "0.1.15", world: "world-template-2"
  });
  const SCENE_KEY = "dbx.heist.kurth.m02.reception";
  const SCENE_TITLE = "Kurth Tower Reception — M02 (Geometry QA)";
  const FLAG = "dicebox-campaign-helper";
  const ART_FOLDER = "dicebox-campaign-helper";
  const SOURCE_PNG_SHA256 = "a342988f238b42162af2052ed37fc4513c9dff1553e6c64a83273aeb5c4371f4";
  const EMBEDDED_WEBP_SHA256 = "95aca5e9010def8d9d8ffea2e11dde2a5f8c0948de2970b461e779175620234a";
  const EMBEDDED_WEBP_BYTES = 425026;
  const ART_NAME = "kurth-m02-structural-95aca5e9-4800x2880.webp";
  const BLUEPRINT_CHECK = "selected-art-geometry-v1-15-of-15-local-only";
  const INSTALL_STATUS = "PROVISIONAL_QA_NOT_READY_TO_PLAY";
  const logical = n => Math.round(n * DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.gridSize);
  const customFlags = objectKey => ({[FLAG]: {sceneKey: SCENE_KEY, objectKey, geometryStatus: BLUEPRINT_CHECK}});
  const filePicker = foundry?.applications?.apps?.FilePicker ?? globalThis.FilePicker;

  // An authored *subset* of gameplay Walls. D01 is a visible angled passage, not a validated closed exterior Door.
  // Array: [stableId,x1,y1,x2,y2,doorKind(0=solid,1=ordinary hinged)]
  const WALL_SPEC = [["W01",31.32798,5.93203,31.32798,6.00618,0],["W02",31.32798,8.30484,31.32798,10.50463,0],["W03",31.32798,14.97837,31.32798,17.10402,0],["W04",31.32798,21.55304,31.32798,23.97528,0],["W05",23.61952,13.66838,23.61952,21.62719,0],["W06",23.61952,13.66838,27.44904,13.66838,0],["W07",23.61952,21.62719,28.36319,21.62719,0],["W08",28.36319,19.97116,28.36319,21.62719,0],["D02",31.32798,6.00618,31.32798,8.30484,1],["D03",31.32798,10.50463,31.32798,14.97837,1],["D04",31.32798,17.10402,31.32798,21.55304,1]];
  const REGION_SPEC = [{"key":"dbx.heist.m02.arrival.reception","name":"Arrival — bridge-end courtyard","box":[17.0,7.7,18.4,9.3],"color":"#396f90"},{"key":"dbx.heist.m02.check.credentials","name":"Screening — reception checkpoint","box":[29.4,12.4,31.2,14.2],"color":"#886a35"},{"key":"dbx.heist.m02.access.staff","name":"Staff corridor cue","box":[29.7,18.8,31.0,20.2],"color":"#71864d"},{"key":"dbx.heist.m02.transition.security-machinery","name":"Exit intent — Security Machinery M03","box":[37.3,12.0,39.0,13.6],"color":"#5e488f"}];
  const IMAGE_CHUNKS = [
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",

    ""
  ];

  function stopUnless(cond, message) {if (!cond) throw new Error(message);}

  function checkRuntime() {
    stopUnless(game?.world?.id === EXPECT.world,
      `Wrong world: expected ${EXPECT.world}; detected ${game?.world?.id || "unknown"}`);
    stopUnless(game?.user?.isGM === true, "Active GM authority required");
    const gms=game.users.filter(u=>u.active && u.isGM);
    stopUnless(gms.length===1 && gms[0].id===game.user.id &&
      game.users.activeGM?.id===game.user.id, "Exactly one active GM must be this client");
    stopUnless(game.version===EXPECT.core && game.system?.id===EXPECT.system &&
      game.system?.version===EXPECT.systemVersion, "Exact Foundry/dnd5e version check failed");
    const m=game.modules.get(EXPECT.module);
    stopUnless(m?.active===true && m.version===EXPECT.moduleVersion,
      `Expected active ${EXPECT.module}@${EXPECT.moduleVersion}`);
    stopUnless(typeof filePicker?.upload==="function" && typeof filePicker?.browse==="function" &&
      typeof filePicker?.createDirectory==="function", "Foundry v14 FilePicker API missing");
    stopUnless(typeof foundry?.applications?.api?.DialogV2?.confirm==="function", "Foundry DialogV2.confirm unavailable");
    stopUnless(typeof crypto?.subtle?.digest==="function" && typeof createImageBitmap==="function",
      "SHA256 or image decoder unavailable");
    const existing=game.scenes.filter(s=>s.getFlag(FLAG,"sceneKey")===SCENE_KEY);
    // After creating this Scene, allow ONLY its newly returned ID through reread gates.
    const isOurNewScene=s=>Boolean(newlyCreatedSceneId && s.id===newlyCreatedSceneId);
    stopUnless(existing.length===0 || (existing.length===1 && isOurNewScene(existing[0])),
      "M02 Scene collision: another managed Scene exists; no duplicate or overwrite allowed");
    stopUnless(!game.scenes.some(s=>s.name===SCENE_TITLE && !isOurNewScene(s)),
      "Same-named foreign Scene exists; refusing overwrite");
    stopUnless(!game.scenes.some(s=>s.getFlag(FLAG,"stableSceneId")===SCENE_KEY && !isOurNewScene(s)),
      "Another Scene owns this stable scene identity");
  }

  function checkGeometry() {
    stopUnless(WALL_SPEC.length===11 && REGION_SPEC.length===4,
      "Unexpected authored Wall/Region count");
    stopUnless(WALL_SPEC.filter(x=>x[5]===1).length===3,
      "Exactly three checkpoint Doors must be present");
    for (const [key,x1,y1,x2,y2,door] of WALL_SPEC) {
      stopUnless([x1,y1,x2,y2].every(Number.isFinite) &&
        x1>=0 && x1<=40 && x2>=0 && x2<=40 &&
        y1>=0 && y1<=24 && y2>=0 && y2<=24 &&
        Math.hypot(x2-x1,y2-y1)>0.01 && (door===0 || door===1),
        `Invalid authored Wall ${key}`);
    }
    for (const r of REGION_SPEC) stopUnless(r.box[0]>=0 && r.box[1]>=0 &&
      r.box[2]<=40 && r.box[3]<=24 && r.box[2]>r.box[0] && r.box[3]>r.box[1],
      `Invalid proposed Region ${r.key}`);
  }

  async function getDigest(input) {
    const bytes=input instanceof ArrayBuffer?input:
      input.buffer.slice(input.byteOffset,input.byteOffset+input.byteLength);
    const buffer=await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256",bytes);
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buffer),b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
  }

  async function bitmap(blob) {
    const obj=await createImageBitmap(blob);
    const size=[obj.width,obj.height];
    obj.close();
    return size;
  }

  async function unpackImage() {
    const raw=atob(IMAGE_CHUNKS.join(""));
    const arr=new Uint8Array(raw.length);
    for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++)arr[i]=raw.charCodeAt(i);
    stopUnless(arr.byteLength===EMBEDDED_WEBP_BYTES,"Embedded WebP byte-count mismatch");
    stopUnless((await getDigest(arr))===EMBEDDED_WEBP_SHA256,"Embedded WebP SHA-256 mismatch");
    stopUnless(String.fromCharCode(...arr.subarray(0,4))==="RIFF" &&
      String.fromCharCode(...arr.subarray(8,12))==="WEBP", "Invalid RIFF/WebP signature");
    const blob=new Blob([arr],{type:"image/webp"});
    const [w,h]=await bitmap(blob);
    stopUnless(w===1619 && h===971,"Selected source image dimensions unexpectedly changed");
    const source=await createImageBitmap(blob);
    const canvas=document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width=DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.width;
    canvas.height=DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.height;
    const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
    stopUnless(Boolean(ctx),"Canvas 2D is unavailable");
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;
    ctx.imageSmoothingQuality="high";
    ctx.drawImage(source,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    source.close();
    const finished=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>canvas.toBlob(
      b=>b?resolve(b):reject(new Error("WebP canvas encoding failed")),"image/webp",0.87));
    stopUnless(finished.type==="image/webp" && finished.size>50000,
      "Encoded scene WebP payload invalid");
    const [fw,fh]=await bitmap(finished);
    stopUnless(fw===DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.width && fh===DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.height,
      "Resized artwork is not exactly 4800x2880");
    return {blob:finished,sha256:await getDigest(await finished.arrayBuffer())};
  }

  async function approvePreview() {
    const html=`<p><b>${SCENE_TITLE}</b> — Geometry QA scene only.</p>`+
      `<p>Detected world: <code>${game.world.id}</code>. Sole active GM: ${game.user.name}.</p>`+
      `<p><b>Art:</b> user-selected grayscale, SHA-256 ${SOURCE_PNG_SHA256.slice(0,12)}…, `+
      `embedded as compressed WebP. Installs a 4800×2880 Gridless background.</p>`+
      `<p><b>Creates:</b> one Scene, ${WALL_SPEC.length} authored Walls `+
      `(3 interior security Doors), ${REGION_SPEC.length} GM-hidden intent Regions with zero behaviors.</p>`+
      `<p><b>UNRESOLVED:</b> exterior entrance and inherited bridge walls are not certified; `+
      `the three route tests are authored-geometry-only. No teleport, actor, puzzle or token installation.</p>`+
      `<p><strong>NOT READY-TO-PLAY.</strong> No existing Scene will be replaced. Cancel performs no writes.</p>`;
    const result=await foundry.applications.api.DialogV2.confirm({
      window:{title:"DiceBox — M02 Provisional Install Preview"},
      content:html,modal:true,rejectClose:false,
      yes:{label:"Install QA Scene"},no:{label:"Cancel"}
    });
    if(result!==true) return false;
    checkRuntime();
    return true;
  }

  async function uploadVerifiedImage(bundle) {
    try {await filePicker.browse("data",ART_FOLDER);}
    catch(_){await filePicker.createDirectory("data",ART_FOLDER);}
    checkRuntime();
    const target=`${ART_FOLDER}/${ART_NAME}`;
    const listing=await filePicker.browse("data",ART_FOLDER);
    let src=target;
    const exists=(listing.files??[]).some(f=>String(f).split(/[?#]/)[0]===target);
    if (!exists) {
      const result=await filePicker.upload("data",ART_FOLDER,
        new File([bundle.blob],ART_NAME,{type:"image/webp"}),{}, {notify:false});
      stopUnless(Boolean(result?.path),"Asset upload returned no source path");
      src=result.path;
    }
    const response=await fetch(src,{cache:"no-store"});
    stopUnless(response.ok,`Uploaded image is not accessible: ${response.status}`);
    const stored=await response.arrayBuffer();
    stopUnless(await getDigest(stored)===bundle.sha256,
      "The on-disk asset does not match this macro (collision/overwrite refused)");
    const [w,h]=await bitmap(new Blob([stored],{type:"image/webp"}));
    stopUnless(w===DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.width && h===DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.height,
      "Uploaded background dimensions differ from Scene scale");
    return src;
  }

  function wallDocs(levelId) {
    return WALL_SPEC.map(([key,x1,y1,x2,y2,door])=>({
      c:[logical(x1),logical(y1),logical(x2),logical(y2)],
      move:1,sight:1,light:1,sound:1,door,ds:0,dir:0,
      flags:{[FLAG]:{sceneKey:SCENE_KEY,objectKey:key,levelId,qaStatus:INSTALL_STATUS}}
    }));
  }
  function regionDocs(levelId) {
    const gmVisibility=CONST.REGION_VISIBILITY?.GAMEMASTER ?? 1;
    return REGION_SPEC.map(r=>({
      name:r.name,color:r.color,hidden:true,visibility:gmVisibility,locked:false,
      ownership:{default:0,[game.user.id]:3},levels:[levelId],behaviors:[],
      shapes:[{type:"rectangle",x:logical(r.box[0]),y:logical(r.box[1]),
        width:logical(r.box[2]-r.box[0]),height:logical(r.box[3]-r.box[1]),rotation:0}],
      flags:customFlags(r.key)
    }));
  }

  function validateDocs(scene,walls,regions) {
    const WC=CONFIG.Wall?.documentClass;
    const RC=CONFIG.Region?.documentClass;
    stopUnless(WC&&RC,"Wall/Region document API unavailable");
    for(const doc of walls) new WC(doc,{parent:scene}).validate({strict:true});
    for(const doc of regions) new RC(doc,{parent:scene}).validate({strict:true});
  }

  function verifyInstalled(scene,src,levelId) {
    const fresh=game.scenes.get(scene.id);
    stopUnless(fresh?.getFlag(FLAG,"sceneKey")===SCENE_KEY,"Scene authoritative reread failed");
    stopUnless(fresh.width===DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.width &&
      fresh.height===DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.height && fresh.padding===0,
      "Scene pixel dimensions/padding changed");
    stopUnless(fresh.grid.type===DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.gridType &&
      fresh.grid.size===DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.gridSize,
      "Gridless scale differs");
    stopUnless(fresh.levels?.get(levelId)?.background?.src===src,"Default Level art binding differs");
    const foundWalls=[...fresh.walls].filter(x=>x.getFlag(FLAG,"sceneKey")===SCENE_KEY);
    const foundRegions=[...fresh.regions].filter(x=>x.getFlag(FLAG,"sceneKey")===SCENE_KEY);
    stopUnless(foundWalls.length===WALL_SPEC.length,"Wall count differs on reread");
    stopUnless(foundRegions.length===REGION_SPEC.length,"Region count differs on reread");
    stopUnless(foundWalls.filter(x=>x.door===1).length===3,"Security Door count differs");
    stopUnless(foundRegions.every(x=>x.behaviors.size===0),"Unexpected Region behaviors");
    const ownedWallKeys=new Set(foundWalls.map(x=>x.getFlag(FLAG,"objectKey")));
    stopUnless(WALL_SPEC.every(x=>ownedWallKeys.has(x[0])),"Stable Wall keys not persisted");
    return {sceneId:fresh.id,sceneUuid:fresh.uuid,levelId,
      walls:foundWalls.length,doors:3,regions:foundRegions.length,asset:src};
  }

  let phase="PREFLIGHT";
  let newlyCreatedSceneId=null;
  try {
    checkGeometry();
    checkRuntime();
    phase="PREVIEW";
    const approved=await approvePreview();
    if (!approved) {console.log("DiceBox M02 cancelled; no writes performed.");return;}
    checkRuntime();
    phase="DECODE_IMAGE";
    const bundle=await unpackImage();
    checkRuntime();
    phase="ASSET_UPLOAD";
    const src=await uploadVerifiedImage(bundle);
    checkRuntime();
    phase="CREATE_SCENE";
    const scene=await Scene.create({
      name:SCENE_TITLE,navName:SCENE_TITLE,navigation:false,
      width:DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.width,height:DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.height,padding:0,
      backgroundColor:"#101010",tokenVision:false,
      grid:{type:DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.gridType,size:DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.gridSize,
        distance:DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.distance,units:DICEBOX_SCENE_SCALE.units},
      flags:{[FLAG]:{sceneKey:SCENE_KEY,stableSceneId:SCENE_KEY,
        sourceSelectedArtSha256:SOURCE_PNG_SHA256,sourceWebpSha256:EMBEDDED_WEBP_SHA256,
        uploadedImageSha256:bundle.sha256,geometryCheck:BLUEPRINT_CHECK,
        installStatus:"CREATING_PROVISIONAL",readyToPlay:false}}
    });
    stopUnless(Boolean(scene),"Scene.create returned no Scene");
    newlyCreatedSceneId=scene.id;
    stopUnless(scene.levels?.size===1 && scene.firstLevel,
      "Unexpected default Level count; preserve partial Scene for recovery");
    const level=scene.firstLevel;
    phase="BIND_ART";
    await level.update({background:{src}});
    stopUnless(level.background?.src===src,"Default Level did not bind the selected image");
    const docsWalls=wallDocs(level.id),docsRegions=regionDocs(level.id);
    validateDocs(scene,docsWalls,docsRegions);
    checkRuntime();
    phase="CREATE_WALLS";
    await scene.createEmbeddedDocuments("Wall",docsWalls);
    phase="CREATE_REGIONS";
    await scene.createEmbeddedDocuments("Region",docsRegions);
    phase="REREAD";
    const proof=verifyInstalled(scene,src,level.id);
    phase="RECEIPT";
    await scene.setFlag(FLAG,"injectionReceipt",{
      ...proof, installedAt:new Date().toISOString(),installedInWorld:game.world.id,
      activeGM:game.user.id,stage:INSTALL_STATUS,geometryOnlyQA:true,
      selectedArtSha256:SOURCE_PNG_SHA256,verifiedUploadedArtSha256:bundle.sha256,
      gameplayVerified:false,readyToPlay:false,
      fullExteriorWallsInstalled:false,teleportsBound:false,npcsInstalled:false,
      inheritedM01WallReread:false,stairHeightRuntimeVerified:false
    });
    console.log("DiceBox M02 provisional injection receipt",proof);
    ui.notifications.info(`M02 QA Scene created: ${proof.walls} Walls, ${proof.regions} Regions. NOT Ready-to-Play.`);
  } catch(err) {
    console.error(`DiceBox M02 macro blocked in ${phase}:`,err);
    console.error("M02 partial-scene recovery hint:",{sceneId:newlyCreatedSceneId,phase});
    ui.notifications.error(`M02 stopped at ${phase}: ${err.message}. Do not rerun blindly.`);
  }
})();
```

### Verification boundary

This macro does **not** place Actors, teleport RegionBehaviors, puzzles, skiffs, or final gameplay-level Walls. It cannot fix mismatch between painted stone and missing exterior/inherited geometry. The sole-GM / exact-world gates and the preview enforce authorization; final READY requires runtime rereads and movement canaries. If it stops after an upload or partial Scene creation, inspect the world and console receipt before retrying.
